dedupe_keys.name: jordan ministry of water and irrigation open tables dam storage and inflows wastewater treatment plants desalination water sources and surface water budget

description: The Jordanian Ministry of Water and Irrigation publishes 17 small datasets on the national open government data portal. Contents: storage capacity, end-of-year storage, total inflow and outflow in million cubic metres for each dam (King Talal, Wadi al-Arab, Mujib, Wala and others; 2018 and 2019), desert dams by basin, a list of wastewater treatment plants with treatment type, year of construction, design capacity in cubic metres per day and average inflow, desalination plants, total water sources and quantities by source and use for 2018 and 2019, the surface water budget, and water projects by governorate. Producer: the Ministry of Water and Irrigation. Coverage: Jordan, with most tables for single years between 2018 and 2023. Format and access: CSV, XLSX and PDF downloads from the portal, whose CKAN API accepts POST requests only. Free under the portal's default open licence. Caveats: each table is a one-off snapshot, not a series, some CSV files use Arabic Windows encoding with semicolons, and there are no coordinates, so plants and dams must be located from other sources. Simulation uses: capacity and flow inputs for water supply and wastewater system models in a water-scarce country, drought and reservoir storage scenarios, and treated wastewater reuse planning. Related records: the Jordan water-focused social accounting matrix (data-jordan-water-focused-social-accounting-matrix-2015) and the 2015 census housing and water tables (data-dos-jordan-census-2015-buildings-housing-water-and-heating-tables).
